raw_segments.text: And if there were a contest, and he had to compete in measuring the shadows with the
prisoners who had never moved out of the den, while his sight was still weak, and before
his eyes had become steady, and the time which would be needed to acquire this new habit
of sight might be very considerable, would he not be ridiculous?
Men would say of him that up he went and down he came without his eyes, and that it was
better not even to think of ascending, and if anyone tried to loose another and lead
him up to the light, let them only catch the offender, and they would put him to death.
